info.name: Stability AI Stable Fast 3D 3D Generation Generate SD3 API
Generate an image using Stable Diffusion 3

items.docs: Generates an image using Stable Diffusion 3 or 3.5 models. Supports both text-to-image and image-to-image generation modes. When an image is provided along with a prompt, the model uses it as a reference guided by the strength parameter. Requests use multipart form data encoding.
